stats.limitations: Boehm counters stop at collection boundaries; not exact total allocation or live bytes and omit the final allocation tail.

measurement.raw_gc_diagnostics: Full GC_PRINT_STATS output is embedded in each gc_stats row; raw_path remains a scratch copy.
measurement.rss_interpretation: Many small application rows report exactly 23,826,432 bytes because wait4 ru_maxrss carries the inherited launcher high-water mark across fork/exec; treat this as an RSS floor, not the small app's actual heap.
measurement.timing_boundary: fresh application process including CLI startup, input read, computation, and output write; build and input generation outside timing
measurement.timing_tool: Python time.perf_counter around fresh Popen child; os.wait4 rusage
